target_stack: Tcl retained for method scripts (UTF-8 for new/edited files; ISO-8859-1/CRLF kept for files patched downstream) with HomeMatic script (.hms); same bridges tclrpc.so and tclrega.so; single JSON serializer; schema-validated params (JSON Schema data files); JSON-RPC 1.1 as v1 plus additive JSON v2 paths; tcltest contract tests with mock bridges in GitHub Actions; lighttpd CGI, ReGaHss, CMake/Make and OpenCCU packaging unchanged; optional FastCGI/reverse-proxy gateway (C++ per repo toolchain or Tcl) only if gated in.
strategy: Refactor in place, safety-net first (D002, D020). Shared layers before features: Phase 0 builds the tcltest harness, mock bridges and golden fixtures for the registry methods and removes or CI-checks the stale www/api copy; Phase 1 closes exposure (backup CGIs stay ADMIN + empty allow-list, not removed now; createFile/existsFile allow-lists incl. 2 existsFile patterns, exec audit, Session.logout, reduced help page, checksid path fix); Phase 2 hardens the dispatcher and security-session (single serializer, error sanitisation + correlation id, whitelisting, strict mode, CSPRNG sid, explicit config-tool flag, registry cache); Phase 3 adds the 179-entry method schema and central validation (fixes ARGUMENTS gaps); Phase 4 adds v2 read endpoints first (rpc, batch, schema, model, profile), then edit endpoints once EG-6 is prototyped; Phase 5 adds event queue fixes and the long-poll endpoint, with the datapoint producer gated by EG-2; Phase 6 measures and decides on the optional gateway. v1 behaviour is frozen under default configuration at every step (NFR-045) and every phase is a revertible change to the Tcl tree. Within a phase, tasks follow the dependency order of functional_trace (dependencies[]) with the contract owner (behavioral contract) written test-first.
